literal_meaning: মনে করা (শাব্দিক অর্থ: মনের মধ্যে করা বা চিন্তা করা)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি মনে করো না যে সবকিছু সহজেই হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Don't assume that everything will happen easily.
We consider this to be true.
history: Referenced in the works of Solil Chaudhuri, a prominent Bengali writer, illustrating a sense of presumptuous loss or defeat in expectations.
note: The idiom often implies a tentative or presumptive belief, rooted in Bengali literary expression.
